name: Bergerac
description: Ex-cop Jim Bergerac is forced to confront a troubling past case when a wealthy woman is murdered, pushing him to overcome personal demons and reignite his investigative prowess to navigate family tensions and law enforcement scrutiny.

videos.title: Bergerac meets Bergerac
videos.overview: A 10 minute interview between Damien Molony and John Nettles (titled Bergerac Meets Bergerac) which sees the pair discussing a number of topics including spending time on the island of Jersey and what fans of the original can expect from the new reboot.

videos.title: Person of Interest
videos.overview: When a member of one of Jersey's wealthiest families is murdered, the police want Bergerac on the case.

videos.title: Play Nicely
videos.overview: Bergerac doesn't care how many cages he rattles in his quest to find kidnapped baby Lily.

videos.title: Alone, Alas, Alone
videos.overview: A threatening letter corroborates Bergerac's hunch that they have the wrong people in custody.

videos.title: Different Rules Apply
videos.overview: Chloe finds evidence proving there's some truth in John Blakely's accusations.

videos.title: Run the Story
videos.overview: A revelation about the night of Cate's murder changes everything.

videos.title: Fred
videos.overview: Bergerac has a shocking realisation about the case.

videos.title: The King of Jersey
videos.overview: Bergerac returns for the most challenging case of his career when shocking events unfold at a wedding reception on the island.

videos.title: A Small Affair
videos.overview: Bergerac looks into Nicola's shocking accusation, but is more focused on pursuing the possible role of police corruption in Tony's murder.

videos.title: Lone Wolf
videos.overview: Relations between Bergerac and Barney reach breaking point as the hunt for the killer intensifies. Meanwhile, Ruth visits Monica to explore her suspicions.

videos.title: Look Who's Back
videos.overview: Bergerac's pursuit of Monica has unexpected and dangerous consequences. New suspects emerge that rock Bergerac to his core.

videos.title: Our Man in Bermuda
videos.overview: Still reeling from the revelation about Alun and with Monica exonerated, the spotlight of suspicion falls upon Nicola. Bergerac is left with his career on the line.

videos.title: No More Secrets
videos.overview: Trapped and desperate, Bergerac must negotiate for his life while still drawing together the threads of the mystery. Meanwhile, Nigel has a surprise for Charlie.
